category_title: Non-dominant students with low displays of aggression
minimal_context: The student is in a collaborative science group looking at photos of animals to discuss their attitudes towards other species.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today in our science group, we are going to look at these photos of animals and talk about our attitudes towards other species and nature.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually just step on the ants and pull flowers or damage plants when I am outside.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What about when you interact with larger animals, like pets?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: If my dog misbehaves, I just scare her, like with a newspaper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What happens if scaring her doesn't work or if you are upset?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I hit my dog a lot. I just hit him when I get mad.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Today in our science group, we are going to look at these photos of animals and talk about our attitudes towards other species and nature.

STUDENT: I usually just step on the ants and pull flowers or damage plants when I am outside.

TUTOR: What about when you interact with larger animals, like pets?

STUDENT: If my dog misbehaves, I just scare her, like with a newspaper.

TUTOR: What happens if scaring her doesn't work or if you are upset?

STUDENT: I hit my dog a lot. I just hit him when I get mad.

task.content: identifying our perceptions, thoughts, and attitudes to others species and nature
task.learning_goal: encouraging compassionate attitudes towards animals through gaining an understanding of their needs, emotions, capacities, current situations and their similarities with humans

context.materials: diverse pedagogical resources such as photos, documentaries, videos

related_quotes: Because before I used to hit my dog a lot and now not so much as before. I try to control myself when I get mad.

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with small animals and plants
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: step now on the ants and do not pull flowers or damage plants

behavior_patterns.condition: When trying to manage an animal's behavior
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: scare her, like with a newspaper
